item.title: Obituary - Donald Porter
item.description: Donald Lee Porter, age 89, passed away Sunday, December 28, 2025. He was born on October 31, 1936 in Kansas City, Kansas the son of R.A. and Roxie Smith Porter. He was employed as a maintenance engineer. His long time companion and wife, Phyllis King Porter preceded him in death on August 13, 2015. He enjoyed fishing, gardening, and spending time with his grandchildren. item.title: Obituary - Anthony Riaan Van Dyk
item.description: Anthony Riaan Van Dyk, 48, passed away on Tuesday, December 30, 2025 in Nevada, MO. Funeral services will be held at 10:00 a.m. on Saturday, January 3, 2026 at Ferry Funeral Home in Nevada with Pastor Terry Mosher officiating. Private interment will follow at a later date. The family will receive friends from 5-7:00 p.m. on Friday evening at Ferry Funeral Home. Memorials are suggested in his name to the American Foundation for Suicide Prevention c/o Ferry Funeral Home.
